name: Backstroke Technique Basics: Body Position & Arm Recovery
steps: Push off the wall on your back in a streamlined position, ears in the water and hips near the surface.
Keep your head still and eyes looking straight up at the ceiling to maintain a stable, horizontal body line.
Practice a gentle flutter kick from the hips (not the knees) to keep your legs light and near the surface.
Perform slow-motion arm recovery, bringing one straight arm out of the water thumb-first, then rotating so the pinky enters the water first at full extension.
Focus on rolling your shoulders and hips together with each arm stroke to engage core rotation rather than just arms.
Pause briefly at the top of each recovery to check arm is straight and entry point is in line with your shoulder.
Repeat slowly, emphasizing smooth, controlled movements over speed.
